profile.headline: Software Engineer at Kin
profile.summary: I can't spend all day solving static functions like when I was a civil engineering student, but I still love solving problems and learning new things. I spent 3.5 years as a quality engineer heavily focused on the testing side. Then I jumped over to the other side as a software engineer where I've been for the last 9 years as a full stack developer efficiently transforming and storing data and effectively displaying it to the client while creating reusable components and scalable applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack developer working in a fast-paced start up developing a web platform to
standardize care, identify care gaps, and streamline the charting involved in
women’s healthcare using Vue and AngularJS, Ruby and Ruby on Rails, and PostgreSQL

- Developed new features, extended and maintained existing functionality, and implemented REST
API services
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · HTML · CSS · JavaScript · Ruby on Rails · MongoDB · Vue.js · Git · Databases · Front-End Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack developer working on end-to-end development of a multi-tenancy application
framework for the management of research labs using Angular and Node.js with MongoDB

- Developed, maintained, and executed end-to-end and unit tests in Cypress
- Managed and set team priorities and timeline using Agile practices, performed code
reviews, and on-boarded and mentor new team members
- Contributed to user-centric interface design and functionality decisions, documented
procedures, processes, and bugs
- Consulted frequently with project owners and stakeholders to determine future
efforts/goals, problems, testing methods, and best practices
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Angular · HTML · CSS · Bootstrap · JavaScript · MongoDB · Git · Databases · React.js · Node.js · Front-End Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack web developer responsible for end-to-end web app development of a user friendly site to visualize scheduled and planned satellite maneuvers, potential satellite collisions, and trending data for a fleet of satellites using Angular, Node.js, and MySQL

- Full stack web developer working on a large scale C# .NET project developing a Windows
MVVM WPF application that manages satellite missions
- Utilized and integrated LDAP for user identification
- Deployed and maintained backend services on Kubernetes
- Created training documents for end users, perform code reviews, on-boarded new software engineering team members, recorded and presented demos to clients, consulted frequently with clients on project status, proposals, and technical issues
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Angular · C# · HTML · CSS · Bootstrap · JavaScript · Java · Git · Databases · Node.js · Front-End Development

positions.title: Senior Quality Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Quality Engineer (November 2016 - February 2017)
Quality Engineer (August 2013 - November 2016)

Led a team of 3 Quality Engineers through software product development life cycle

- Investigated root causes of bugs, tested and validated frontend and backend software and firmware products
- Developed tools and created integration tests in C# to perform end-to-end testing of new backend
features and software products
- Wrote Python scripts using Selenium to load test existing systems and to analyze potential scalability and performance issues
- Mentored and trained new Quality Engineers
- Documented procedures, processes, and bugs on JIRA and Confluence
positions.insights: Skills: C# · HTML · Python · CSS · Databases

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Graduate Research Assistant within the Civil Engineering Department under Dr. Cinzia Cirillo focusing on Transportation research

- Acquired, cleaned, and analyzed national data sets in R and GIS to identify major transportation corridors
- Modeled preferred mode choice given origin and destination using discrete choice modeling techniques in R and GIS
- Researched and wrote literature reviews and technical papers on transportation accessibility
- Organized focus group for community input on transportation and job accessibility

Received Dwight David Eisenhower Transportation Fellowship and the University of Maryland, University Fellowship for the project.

positions.title: Transportation Intern
positions.description:
Worked with Dr. Celik Ozyildirim on self consolidating concrete

- Researched and mixed self consolidating concrete for potential bridge retrofit

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Undergraduate Research Assistant within the Mechanical and Aerospace Department under Dr. Pamela Norris in the Soft Materials Laboratory with Research Scientist Dr. Donald Jordan and graduate student Christina Haden

- Produced polypyrrole membranes through electro-polymerization
- Fabricated and tested potassium ion-selective electrodes
- Collected and analyzed experimental data on ion passive diffusion through a polymer membrane
using LabVIEW and MatLab

Received the Virginia Space Grant Consortium (VSGC) Undergraduate STEM Research Scholarship Program, Ligon-Lamsam Opportunity Fund: Research Scholarship in 2011. The project was winner of the University of Virginia, Undergraduate Research and Design Symposium, Individual Category, 2011. The project was featured in the University of Virginia's School of Engineering & Applied Science's Impact Magazine, Spring 2011.

positions.title: Technical Writer Intern
positions.description:
- Created technical manual for the assembly of a multi-functional probe
- Prepared and performed Qualification Test Procedures
- Rendered schematics in Microsoft Visio

organizations.name: Chi Epsilon - Civil Engineering Honor Society
